name: Dani Oliveros
bio: Dani Oliveros was born in Palm Beach Gardens, FL. She first joined the industry as a model in New York City after graduating from performing arts high school in Florida. She traveled throughout major U.S. cities and Europe working full time as a model before moving to Los Angeles, where she started acting. Dani started in commercials and has transitioned to pursuing acting full time, focusing on feature films.

credits.title: A Place in Hell
credits.overview: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

credits.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
credits.overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

credits.title: The Bay
credits.overview: Best friends Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

credits.title: Skillhouse
credits.overview: Ten influencers are lured into a sinister content house and forced to compete in lethal social media challenges — because in Skillhouse, clout isn’t just currency, it’s survival.

credits.title: Outbreak
credits.overview: A State Park Ranger and his wife, grappling with the disappearance of their teenage son, face a mysterious outbreak that threatens not only their relationship, but in the end, their grip on reality.

credits.title: God's Not Dead: We The People
credits.overview: Reverend Dave has to defend himself and a group of Christian homeschooling families after an inspection by local government officials.

credits.title: Angie: Lost Girls
credits.overview: After escaping from a sex trafficking ring, one teenage girl struggles to reconnect with herself and her family. To rescue her helpless friends, she must confront her own fears and help lead the police to her traffickers - at all costs.

credits.title: God's Gracie
credits.overview: When Gracie, a thirteen year-old Fundamentalist Christian, meets Heidi, an agnostic lesbian driving back from her mother's funeral, Gracie must find a new approach to save a soul.
